svg.title: Tessera: a tensor compiler for Apple silicon
svg.desc: A tensor compiler that takes ONNX models through graph fusion, a TensorIR-style loop IR and an autotuner with a learned cost model, to C with NEON and SME microkernels or to Metal. On the M4 GPU it beats every baseline on all four models, GPT-2 by 1.56 times over PyTorch MPS, with every output within 3e-6 of ONNX Runtime. Chart: batch-1 latency in milliseconds for ResNet-50, MobileNetV2, BERT-base and GPT-2: ResNet-50 10.71 Tessera, 12.28 PyTorch MPS, 12.14 ONNX Runtime CPU; MobileNetV2 1.74 Tessera, 6.62 PyTorch MPS, 2.43 ONNX Runtime CPU; BERT-base 10.31 Tessera, 14.85 PyTorch MPS, 21.97 ONNX Runtime CPU; GPT-2 14.18 Tessera, 22.13 PyTorch MPS, 30.54 ONNX Runtime CPU.
